title: The Pink Candy Cane Christmas Kitchen
description: A pink candy cane Christmas kitchen: a pink ceramic light-up tree, a candy-stripe mug, pink Santa and Fa la la kitchen towels, a pink gingerbread truck, a pom pom garland and pink peppermint ornaments.
intro: I told myself I was only buying one ceramic Christmas tree this year. It is pink, it lights up, it has a bow on top, and it now runs my kitchen. Then came the candy-stripe mug, the Fa la la towels, a tiny pink truck with a cookie box in the back and a pom pom garland across the island. The whole kitchen smells like peppermint and looks like a candy shop and I'm not sorry.

sections.heading: The tree is the star
paragraphs: A pink ceramic light-up Christmas tree, 15 inches tall with pink bulbs and a bow topper, sits on the island. It is about three times the height of the mug.

sections.heading: Mug, towels and truck
paragraphs: A red and white candy-stripe footed mug with a wrapped-candy handle, a pair of pink kitchen towels with vintage Santas and a Fa la la la print, and a little pink gingerbread metal truck, 5 inches long.

sections.heading: Garland and ornaments
paragraphs: A felt pom pom garland in red, white, light pink and hot pink drapes along the island, and twelve shiny pink peppermint candy ornaments fill a bowl or hang from the cabinet knobs.

sections.heading: What is real and what is styling
paragraphs: The products are the pieces linked here. The rooms, food, furniture and everything else in the photos are styling extras.
Photos are AI-generated styling ideas, so check each listing for the exact item, colour and size before you buy.
